children: Lionheart Holdings said the parties will not renew exclusivity after the LOI with KEO Energy for a proposed business combination lapsed.
Entered non-binding LOI with Keo Capital AB on behalf of KEO Energy on July 15, 2026 for a proposed business combination.
The proposed transaction was not completed during the LOI exclusivity period.
Both parties mutually decided not to renew exclusivity, ending the exclusivity commitment under the LOI.
